heading: Holiday Markets, Lights & Christmas Events in the Okanagan, 2026
title: Okanagan Christmas & Holiday Events 2026 | Okanagan Roam
description: Holiday markets, tree lightings, Christmas concerts, Santa at Big White and New Year's Eve in the Okanagan, from mid-November 2026 into January.
intro: This guide covers the 2026 holiday season, from mid-November through New Year's Day. It gathers the festive events in our listings: holiday markets, tree lightings and light-ups, Christmas concerts, Santa and family days at the ski hills, cozy winery evenings and a few ways to ring in 2027. Dates and details can change, so check each event page before you go.
Events are grouped by type. Each one shows its town and date.

items.name: Festival of Trees at Mission Hill
items.text: a festive display of community-decorated holiday trees, with a guided experience and seasonal wine tasting supporting BC Children's Hospital. This is the 10th annual Festival of Trees.

items.name: Tree of Hope Festival
items.text: the annual tree-lighting tradition in the Landmark District, with festive entertainment, seasonal treats and family-friendly activities. The organizer will announce the detailed schedule closer to the date.
